class InterruptControlMixin:
    """interrupt()/hard_interrupt()/clear_interrupt()/steer()/redirect() (see module docstring)."""

    def interrupt(
        self, message: Optional[str] = None, *, hard_cancel: bool = False,
        tool_reason: Optional[str] = None, require_generation: Optional[int] = None,
    ) -> bool:
        """Request the agent to interrupt its current tool-calling loop (call from another thread).

        ``hard_cancel``: explicit stop; compression may honor it even while ordinary interrupts are masked.
        ``tool_reason``: trusted fixed category safe for tool output. ``require_generation``: activity-
        generation claim ??published only if the turn's generation still matches at the final mutation edge;
        returns False if the turn resumed meanwhile.
        """
        if require_generation is not None:
            # RESERVE the claim under the SAME lock `_touch_activity` stamps with; real progress invalidates
            # it and it is CONSUMED at the final mutation edge, so a resumed turn abandons the abort.
            with self._liveness_activity_lock():
                if getattr(self, "_turn_liveness_activity_generation", 0) != require_generation:
                    return False
                self._turn_liveness_abort_claim = require_generation

        # Tool cancellation attribution stays separate from _interrupt_message, which may carry the user's
        # full next message. An explicit ``tool_reason`` wins on BOTH paths: a system producer that has to
        # stop the turn SOFTLY (batch guards, watchdogs) previously had no way to label itself ??passing a
        # message made it look like "the user sent a new message", so the abort was attributed to the user
        # and rendered as a user-stop placeholder (#130207).
        tool_interrupt_reason = (
            (tool_reason or _REASON_HARD_STOP) if hard_cancel
            else (tool_reason or (_REASON_NEW_MESSAGE if message else _REASON_USER_INTERRUPT))
        )

        def _publish_interrupt_state() -> None:
            # A shutdown stop never relabels a user Stop already pending (the user's Stop wins): the turn
            # records the first cause, so it is not announced as interrupted by the restart. A pending
            # redirect (a mid-request correction) is not a Stop: the restart drops it and is the cause.
            if not (tool_reason == _REASON_GATEWAY_SHUTDOWN and getattr(self, "_interrupt_requested", False)
                    and getattr(self, "_tool_interrupt_reason", None) in USER_INTERRUPT_REASONS):
                self._interrupt_message = message
                self._tool_interrupt_reason = tool_interrupt_reason

    def _finish_slot_away(self, slot: ChatRunSlot, content: str) -> None:
        self._stop_agent_log_activity()
        text = (content or slot.pending_partial or "").strip()
        slot.pending_partial = ""
        if text:
            self._land_assistant_db(
                slot.gate.active_id or "", text, cid=int(slot.conversation_id)
            )
            slot.away_reply = text
            self._request_chat_title(slot.conversation_id)
        self._bound_slot = slot
        try:
            self._maybe_followthrough(text)
            current = slot.gate.finish(slot.gate.active_id)
            slot.worker = None
            if current:
                self._turn_dispatcher.finish_active_turn(current)
        finally:
            self._bound_slot = None
        self._on_chat_turn_finished(int(slot.conversation_id))

    def _fail_slot_away(self, slot: ChatRunSlot) -> None:

        try:

            slot.gate.consume_ignored()

            current = slot.gate.finish(slot.gate.active_id)
            if current:

        finally:
            self._bound_slot = None
        self._on_chat_turn_finished(int(slot.conversation_id))

def _check_map() -> None:

    assert m.get(1) is ChatActivity.IDLE
    assert m.snapshot() == {}

    m.mark_working(1)
    assert m.get(1) is ChatActivity.WORKING
    assert dict(m.snapshot()) == {1: ChatActivity.WORKING}

    m.mark_finished(1, viewing=True)
    assert m.get(1) is ChatActivity.IDLE
    assert m.snapshot() == {}

    m.mark_working(2)
    m.mark_finished(2, viewing=False)
    assert m.get(2) is ChatActivity.DONE

    m.clear_done(2)
    assert m.get(2) is ChatActivity.IDLE

    m.mark_working(3)
    m.clear_done(3)
    assert m.get(3) is ChatActivity.WORKING

    m.mark_finished(3, viewing=False)
    m.mark_working(3)
    assert m.get(3) is ChatActivity.WORKING

    m.mark_finished(99, viewing=False)
    assert m.get(99) is ChatActivity.IDLE


def _check_row_timer(app: QApplication) -> None:
    panel = ChatHistoryPanel()
    panel.set_conversations(
        [ChatConversation(7, "?묒뾽 以?, "", "", 1)],
        active_id=7,
    )
    app.processEvents()
    row = next(
        f for f in panel._inner.findChildren(QFrame) if f.objectName() == "HudChatRow"
    )
    assert row._activity is ChatActivity.IDLE
    assert not row._anim_timer.isActive()

    panel.set_activity({7: ChatActivity.WORKING})
    app.processEvents()
    assert row._activity is ChatActivity.WORKING
    assert row._anim_timer.isActive()
    assert row._badge is not None and not row._badge.isHidden()

    panel.set_activity({7: ChatActivity.DONE})
    app.processEvents()
    assert row._activity is ChatActivity.DONE
    assert not row._anim_timer.isActive()
    assert row._badge is not None and not row._badge.isHidden()

    panel.set_activity({})
    app.processEvents()
    assert row._activity is ChatActivity.IDLE
    assert not row._anim_timer.isActive()
    assert row._badge is not None and row._badge.isHidden()


def main() -> int:
    app = QApplication.instance() or QApplication(sys.argv)
    _check_map()
    _check_row_timer(app)
    print("chat activity OK")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

        apply_generated_title(self.db, conv.id, "트랜스포머와 어텐션")
        self.assertEqual(
                {"role": "assistant", "content": "답변"},
            ],
        )

    def test_start_new_conversation_reuses_empty_session(self) -> None:
        first = start_new_conversation(self.db)
        self.assertEqual(start_new_conversation(self.db), first)

        append_message(self.db, first, "user", "질문")
        second = start_new_conversation(self.db)
        self.assertNotEqual(second, first)
        self.assertEqual(active_conversation_id(self.db), second)
        self.assertEqual(history_dicts(self.db, second), [])

    def test_clear_messages_keeps_session_and_resets_title(self) -> None:
        conv = create_conversation(self.db)
        append_message(self.db, conv.id, "user", "질문")
        clear_conversation_messages(self.db, conv.id)
        reloaded = get_conversation(self.db, conv.id)
        assert reloaded is not None
        self.assertEqual(reloaded.title, DEFAULT_TITLE)
        self.assertEqual(reloaded.message_count, 0)

    def test_delete_conversation_removes_messages(self) -> None:
        conv = create_conversation(self.db)
        append_message(self.db, conv.id, "user", "질문")
        delete_conversation(self.db, conv.id)
        self.assertIsNone(get_conversation(self.db, conv.id))
        self.assertEqual(history_dicts(self.db, conv.id), [])

    def test_deleted_active_session_falls_back(self) -> None:
        keep = create_conversation(self.db)
        append_message(self.db, keep.id, "user", "남길 질문")
        active = create_conversation(self.db)
        set_active_conversation_id(self.db, active.id)

class TurnCancelled:
    pass


TurnEvent = Union[
    ContentDelta,
    ToolProgress,
    AppUiOfferEvent,
    ReasoningDelta,
    TurnFinished,
    TurnFailed,
    TurnCancelled,
]


EngineHome = NewType("EngineHome", Path)
# Directory IRIS owns. Default ~/.iris-light/engine. Not %LOCALAPPDATA%\\hermes.

HermesHome = NewType("HermesHome", Path)
EnginePython = NewType("EnginePython", Path)
GuiPython = NewType("GuiPython", Path)


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class InternalSidecar:
    """Default source. shutdown() kills the child."""

    home: EngineHome
    kill_on_shutdown: Literal[True] = True


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ExternalGateway:
    """Compatibility only. shutdown() disconnects and does not kill."""

    base_url: str
    api_key: str
    kill_on_shutdown: Literal[False] = False


EngineSource = Union[InternalSidecar, ExternalGateway]


def _default_engine_home() -> EngineHome:
    # Product home (= Iris Agent home). Same tree as pin/migrate/supervisor.
    from iris.infrastructure.agent_runtime import iris_agent_home

    return EngineHome(iris_agent_home())


def _settings_flag(settings: object, name: str) -> bool:
    value = getattr(settings, name, False)
    if isinstance(value, str):
        return value.strip().lower() not in {"", "0", "false", "no"}
    return bool(value)


def parse_engine_source(settings: object) -> EngineSource:
    """Settings boundary. Default InternalSidecar.

    ExternalGateway only when settings.hermes_external_gateway is true.
    hermes_enabled stays the 'use the engine' flag. It does not mean ':8642 is up'.
    """
    if _settings_flag(settings, "hermes_external_gateway"):
        return ExternalGateway(
            base_url=str(getattr(settings, "hermes_base_url", "") or ""),
            api_key=str(getattr(settings, "hermes_api_key", "") or ""),
        )
    return InternalSidecar(home=_default_engine_home())


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class EngineReady:
    source: EngineSource
    summary: str


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class EngineFailed:
    error: EngineError

    @property
    def user_message(self) -> str:
        return self.error.user_message


EngineEnsureResult = Union[EngineReady, EngineFailed]


# Product engine catalog == SpeakTools allowlist (not MCP iris-control triple).

"""Default chat path uses shared_engine, not :8642."""

from __future__ import annotations

import inspect
import sys
from pathlib import Path
from types import SimpleNamespace
from unittest import TestCase
from unittest.mock import MagicMock, patch

from PyQt6.QtWidgets import QApplication

_APP = QApplication.instance() or QApplication(sys.argv)

from iris.engine import (  # noqa: E402
    ContentDelta,
    EngineError,
    EngineErrorCode,
    EngineFailed,
    EngineHome,
    EngineReady,
    ExternalGateway,
    InternalSidecar,
    ToolProgress,
    TurnCancelled,
    TurnFinished,
)
from iris.infrastructure.hermes_client import HermesInferenceTarget  # noqa: E402
from iris.ui.workers.hermes_workers import (  # noqa: E402
    HermesChatWorker,
    HermesHealthWorker,
    HermesModelSyncWorker,
)


def _internal() -> InternalSidecar:
    return InternalSidecar(home=EngineHome(Path.home() / ".iris-light" / "engine"))


class _StubEngine:
    def __init__(self, *, ready=None, events=None) -> None:
        self.source = _internal()
        self.ready = ready or EngineReady(self.source, "engine is ready")
        self.events = list(events or [])
        self.turns: list[object] = []
        self.ensure_calls = 0

    def ensure_ready(self):
        self.ensure_calls += 1
        return self.ready

    def run_turn(self, turn):
        self.turns.append(turn)
        yield from self.events


class _Collector:
    def __init__(self, worker) -> None:
        self.ok: list[object] = []
        self.failed: list[str] = []
        self.notice: list[str] = []
        self.content: list[str] = []
        self.tools: list[str] = []
        worker.finished_ok.connect(self.ok.append)
        worker.failed.connect(self.failed.append)
        if hasattr(worker, "notice"):
            worker.notice.connect(self.notice.append)
        if hasattr(worker, "content_chunk"):
            worker.content_chunk.connect(self.content.append)
        if hasattr(worker, "tool_progress"):
            worker.tool_progress.connect(self.tools.append)


class InternalHealthWorkerTests(TestCase):
    def test_constructs_without_gateway_url(self) -> None:
        worker = HermesHealthWorker()
        self.assertIsNotNone(worker)

    def test_engine_ready_finishes_ok_without_starting_8642(self) -> None:
        engine = _StubEngine()
        worker = HermesHealthWorker()
        out = _Collector(worker)
        with (
            patch("iris.ui.workers.hermes_workers.shared_engine", return_value=engine),
            patch(
                "iris.ui.workers.hermes_workers.sync_iris_control",
                return_value=SimpleNamespace(summary_line=lambda: "skip"),
            ),
            patch(
                "iris.ui.workers.hermes_workers.ensure_hermes_gateway_running"
            ) as start_gateway,
            patch("iris.ui.workers.hermes_workers.restart_hermes_gateway") as restart,
        ):
            worker.run()
        self.assertEqual(out.ok, [True])
        self.assertEqual(out.failed, [])
        self.assertEqual(engine.ensure_calls, 1)
        start_gateway.assert_not_called()
        restart.assert_not_called()

    def test_engine_ready_syncs_engine_home_without_reconnecting_gateway(self) -> None:
        engine = _StubEngine()
        worker = HermesHealthWorker()
        out = _Collector(worker)
        report = SimpleNamespace(summary_line=lambda: "engine sync")
        with (
            patch("iris.ui.workers.hermes_workers.shared_engine", return_value=engine),
            patch(
                "iris.ui.workers.hermes_workers.sync_iris_control",
                return_value=report,
            ) as sync,
            patch(
                "iris.ui.workers.hermes_workers.ensure_hermes_gateway_running"
            ) as start_gateway,
            patch("iris.ui.workers.hermes_workers.restart_hermes_gateway") as restart,
        ):
            worker.run()
        self.assertEqual(out.ok, [True])
        self.assertEqual(out.failed, [])
        sync.assert_called_once()
        kwargs = sync.call_args.kwargs
        self.assertEqual(kwargs.get("home"), engine.source.home)
        self.assertIs(kwargs.get("reconnect_gateway"), False)
        start_gateway.assert_not_called()
        restart.assert_not_called()

    def test_engine_failed_emits_user_message(self) -> None:
        error = EngineError(EngineErrorCode.NOT_INSTALLED, "missing")
        engine = _StubEngine(ready=EngineFailed(error))
        worker = HermesHealthWorker()
        out = _Collector(worker)
        with (
            patch("iris.ui.workers.hermes_workers.shared_engine", return_value=engine),
            patch("iris.ui.workers.hermes_workers.sync_iris_control") as sync,
        ):
            worker.run()
        self.assertEqual(out.ok, [])
        self.assertEqual(out.failed, [error.user_message])
        sync.assert_not_called()

        with patch("iris.ui.workers.hermes_workers.shared_engine", return_value=engine):
            worker.run()

        self.assertEqual(out.ok, [])
        self.assertEqual(out.failed, [])

from __future__ import annotations

from pathlib import Path
from tempfile import TemporaryDirectory
from types import SimpleNamespace
from unittest import TestCase
from unittest.mock import patch

from iris.engine import (
    CancelToken,
    ChatTranscript,
    Engine,
    EngineError,
    EngineErrorCode,
    EngineFailed,
    EngineHome,
    EngineReady,
    ExternalGateway,
    InternalSidecar,
    StatelessTurn,
    TurnCancelled,
    TurnFailed,
    parse_engine_source,
    shared_engine,
)
from iris.engine.runtime import _turn_api_key, reset_shared_engine
from iris.infrastructure.hermes_client import HermesInferenceTarget


def _turn(*, cancelled: bool = False) -> StatelessTurn:
    token = CancelToken()
    if cancelled:
        token.cancel()
    return StatelessTurn(
        transcript=ChatTranscript.parse([{"role": "user", "content": "hi"}]),
        model=HermesInferenceTarget(model="llama3.2", provider="custom"),
        cancel=token,
    )


class SharedEngineTests(TestCase):
    def setUp(self) -> None:
        reset_shared_engine()

    def tearDown(self) -> None:
        reset_shared_engine()

    def test_shared_engine_is_public_and_reset_is_not(self) -> None:
        import iris.engine as engine

        self.assertIn("shared_engine", engine.__all__)
        self.assertIn("Engine", engine.__all__)
        self.assertIn("EngineReady", engine.__all__)
        self.assertIn("EngineFailed", engine.__all__)
        self.assertNotIn("reset_shared_engine", engine.__all__)

    def test_shared_engine_returns_the_same_object(self) -> None:
        first = shared_engine()
        second = shared_engine()
        self.assertIs(first, second)

    def test_shutdown_twice_does_not_raise(self) -> None:
        engine = shared_engine()
        engine.shutdown()
        engine.shutdown()


class EngineReadyStubTests(TestCase):
    def setUp(self) -> None:
        self._tmp = TemporaryDirectory()
        self.home = EngineHome(Path(self._tmp.name))
        self._install = patch("iris.engine.runtime.install_into")
        self._install.start()
        self.addCleanup(self._install.stop)

    def tearDown(self) -> None:
        self._tmp.cleanup()

    def _internal(self) -> InternalSidecar:
        return InternalSidecar(home=self.home)

    def test_ensure_ready_on_fresh_sidecar_is_not_installed(self) -> None:
        engine = Engine(self._internal())
        result = engine.ensure_ready()
        self.assertIsInstance(result, EngineFailed)
        self.assertEqual(result.error.code, EngineErrorCode.NOT_INSTALLED)
        self.assertTrue(result.user_message)

    def test_run_turn_yields_one_turn_failed(self) -> None:
        engine = Engine(self._internal())
        events = list(engine.run_turn(_turn()))
        self.assertEqual(len(events), 1)
        self.assertIsInstance(events[0], TurnFailed)
        assert isinstance(events[0], TurnFailed)
        self.assertEqual(events[0].error.code, EngineErrorCode.NOT_INSTALLED)

    def test_cancelled_turn_yields_turn_cancelled(self) -> None:
        engine = Engine(self._internal())
        events = list(engine.run_turn(_turn(cancelled=True)))
        self.assertEqual(events, [TurnCancelled()])

    def test_mid_turn_cancel_kills_child_and_yields_cancelled(self) -> None:
        from unittest.mock import MagicMock

        engine = Engine(self._internal())
        fake = MagicMock()
        fake.poll.return_value = None
        engine._child = fake
        token = CancelToken()
        turn = StatelessTurn(
            transcript=ChatTranscript.parse([{"role": "user", "content": "hi"}]),
            model=HermesInferenceTarget(model="llama3.2", provider="custom"),
            cancel=token,
        )

        def read(*_a, **_k):
            token.cancel()
            return ""

        order: list[str] = []

        def on_stop(*_a, **_k):
            order.append("stop")

        def on_forget(*_a, **_k):
            order.append("forget")

        with (
            patch.object(
                engine,
                "ensure_ready",
                return_value=EngineReady(self._internal(), "ready"),
            ),
            patch.object(engine, "_write_turn"),
            patch("iris.engine.runtime._readline_timeout", side_effect=read),
            patch("iris.engine.runtime._send_stop", side_effect=on_stop),
            patch.object(engine, "_forget_child", side_effect=on_forget),
        ):
            events = list(engine.run_turn(turn))
        self.assertEqual(events, [TurnCancelled()])
        self.assertEqual(order, ["stop", "forget"])

    def test_ollama_turn_sends_compat_api_key(self) -> None:
        turn = StatelessTurn(
            transcript=ChatTranscript.parse([{"role": "user", "content": "hi"}]),
            model=HermesInferenceTarget(
                model="gemma4:e2b",
                provider="custom",
                base_url="http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1",
            ),
            cancel=CancelToken(),
        )
        self.assertEqual(_turn_api_key(turn), "ollama")
        keyed = StatelessTurn(
            transcript=turn.transcript,
            model=HermesInferenceTarget(
                model="gpt",
                provider="custom",
                base_url="https://api.example/v1",
                api_key="sk-user",
            ),
            cancel=CancelToken(),
        )
        self.assertEqual(_turn_api_key(keyed), "sk-user")

class SidecarMainTests(TestCase):
    def test_gui_python_exits_2(self) -> None:
        proc = _run_sidecar_main(_child_env(IRIS_ENGINE_GUI_PYTHON=sys.executable))
        self.assertEqual(proc.returncode, 2)
        self.assertNotIn('"t": "hello"', proc.stdout)
        self.assertNotIn('"t":"hello"', proc.stdout)

    def test_hello_when_not_gui_python(self) -> None:
        proc = _run_sidecar_main(_child_env())
        self.assertEqual(proc.returncode, 0, proc.stderr)
        lines = [line for line in proc.stdout.splitlines() if line.strip()]
        self.assertTrue(lines, "stdout must carry the hello line")
        first = lines[0]
        self.assertEqual(json.loads(first), {"t": "hello", "ok": True})

    def test_hello_when_gui_python_is_a_different_path(self) -> None:
        proc = _run_sidecar_main(_child_env(IRIS_ENGINE_GUI_PYTHON=str(_ROOT / "not-python")))
        self.assertEqual(proc.returncode, 0, proc.stderr)
        first = proc.stdout.splitlines()[0]
        self.assertEqual(json.loads(first), {"t": "hello", "ok": True})

def engine_python(home: EngineHome) -> EnginePython | None:
    venv = Path(home) / "hermes-agent" / "venv"
    if sys.platform == "win32":
        scripts = venv / "Scripts"
        for name in ("python.exe", "python.cmd", "python"):
            candidate = scripts / name
            if candidate.is_file():
                return EnginePython(candidate)
        return None
    candidate = venv / "bin" / "python"
    if candidate.is_file():
        return EnginePython(candidate)
    return None


def _stripped_probe_env(*, home: EngineHome | None, python: Path) -> dict[str, str]:
    env = os.environ.copy()
    for key in _POLLUTION_ENV_KEYS:
        env.pop(key, None)
    if home is not None:
        env["HERMES_HOME"] = str(home)
    venv = python.parent.parent
    if venv.is_dir():
        env["VIRTUAL_ENV"] = str(venv)
        scripts = str(python.parent)
        path = env.get("PATH", "")
        if scripts and not path.lower().startswith(scripts.lower()):
            env["PATH"] = scripts + os.pathsep + path
    return env


def _probe_imports(
    python: Path,
    *,
    home: EngineHome | None = None,
    timeout_sec: float = 25.0,
) -> EngineError | None:
    if not python.is_file():
        return EngineError(EngineErrorCode.NOT_INSTALLED, f"engine python missing: {python}")
    try:
        proc = subprocess.run(
            [str(python), "-c", _PROBE_IMPORT],
            capture_output=True,
            text=True,
            encoding="utf-8",
            errors="replace",
            timeout=max(5.0, timeout_sec),
            check=False,
            env=_stripped_probe_env(home=home, python=python),
            **no_window_kwargs(),
        )
    except (OSError, subprocess.TimeoutExpired) as exc:
        return EngineError(EngineErrorCode.WRONG_PYTHON, f"engine python failed: {exc}")
    err = ((proc.stderr or "") + "\n" + (proc.stdout or "")).strip()
    if proc.returncode != 0:
        detail = err[:400] if err else f"exit {proc.returncode}"
        return EngineError(EngineErrorCode.WRONG_PYTHON, detail)
    if "ok" not in (proc.stdout or ""):
        return EngineError(
            EngineErrorCode.WRONG_PYTHON,
            f"hermes_cli import ?묐떟 ?댁긽: {err[:240]}",
        )
    return None


def probe_engine_python(home: EngineHome) -> EngineError | None:
    try:
        python = engine_python(home)
        if python is None:
            return EngineError(EngineErrorCode.NOT_INSTALLED, "engine python is not installed")
        return _probe_imports(Path(python), home=home)
    except Exception as exc:
        return EngineError(EngineErrorCode.WRONG_PYTHON, str(exc))


def install_into(
    home: EngineHome,
    *,
    clone: object | None = None,
    runner: Callable[..., object] | None = None,
) -> None:
    if probe_engine_python(home) is None:
        return
    dest = Path(home) / "hermes-agent"
    if runner is not None:
        runner(dest, sha=_engine_pin_sha(), clone=clone)
        return
    from iris.system.hermes_install import install_hermes_with_system_python

    result = install_hermes_with_system_python(
        home=Path(home), sha=_engine_pin_sha()
    )
    if result is not None and not getattr(result, "ok", True):
        return

    def _apply_chat_title_heuristic(self, conversation_id: int) -> None:
        from iris.storage.chat_title import apply_heuristic_title

            title = apply_heuristic_title(self._db, int(conversation_id))

        if not title:

    def _on_chat_title_failed(self, conversation_id: int, generation: int) -> None:
        cid = int(conversation_id)
        if int(generation) != self._title_requests.current(cid):
            return
        self._chat_title_workers.pop(cid, None)
        self._apply_chat_title_heuristic(cid)

    def _retitle_project_chat_note(self, conversation_id: int, title: str) -> None:
        shown = " ".join((title or "").split())
        if not shown:
            return
        try:
            from iris.knowledge.history_store import retitle_project_chat
            from iris.knowledge.project_wiki import project_chat_rel
            from iris.storage.chat_projects import project_for_conversation

            project = project_for_conversation(self._db, int(conversation_id))
            if project is None:
                return
            path = self._iris_wiki.user_root / project_chat_rel(project.wiki_slug, int(conversation_id))
            if path.is_file():
                retitle_project_chat(path, shown)
        except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
            self._live_activity.append_instant_line(f"채팅 위키 제목 실패: {str(exc)[:80]}")
        if not seen_user or role != "assistant":
            continue
        body = (content or "").replace(INTERRUPTED_NOTE, "\n").strip()
        if not body:
            continue
        title = summarize_reply(body)
        if title not in ("", DEFAULT_TITLE):
            return title
    return DEFAULT_TITLE


def suggest_title(
    messages: list[ChatMessage] | list[dict[str, str]],
    *,
    basis: str = TITLE_BASIS_LAST,
) -> str:
    """last는 최근 답변의 첫 문장. first는 첫 질문의 작업 제목, 아니면 그 답변."""
    if basis != TITLE_BASIS_FIRST:
        replies = _reply_texts(messages)
        if not replies:
            users = _user_lines(messages)
            if not users:
                return DEFAULT_TITLE
            anchor = _anchor_line(users)
            work = summarize_work_title(anchor)
            if work and not _question_echo(anchor, work):
                return work
            title = summarize_reply(anchor)
            return title if title not in ("", DEFAULT_TITLE) else DEFAULT_TITLE
        title = summarize_reply(replies[-1])
        return title if title not in ("", DEFAULT_TITLE) else DEFAULT_TITLE
    users = _user_lines(messages)
    if not users:
        return DEFAULT_TITLE
    anchor = _anchor_line(users)
    work = summarize_work_title(anchor) if _is_topic_line(anchor) else ""
    if work and not _question_echo(anchor, work):
        return work
    return _first_reply_title(messages)

def _domain_of(action: str) -> str:
    if action in ("ping", "get_catalog", "get_state"):
        return "session"
    if "." in action:
        return action.split(".", 1)[0]
    return "session"


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class SpeakAllowlist:
    """Single hand-maintained product list. Catalog/engine names derive from this."""

    grants: tuple[SpeakGrant, ...]

    def names(self) -> tuple[str, ...]:
        return tuple(sorted(g.action for g in self.grants))

    def grant(self, action: str) -> SpeakGrant | None:
        key = (action or "").strip()
        for g in self.grants:
            if g.action == key:
                return g
        return None

    def engine_names(self) -> tuple[str, ...]:
        return self._allowlist.names()

    def invoke(self, action: str, args: dict[str, Any] | None = None) -> ToolResult:
        key = resolve_legacy_name((action or "").strip())
        payload = dict(args or {})
        grant = self._allowlist.grant(key)
        if grant is None:
            return ToolResult(
                ok=False,
                action=key or (action or ""),
                data={},
                error=f"not_allowed: {key or action}",
            )
        if grant.kind is ExecKind.PURE:
            if key == "get_catalog":
                return ToolResult(
                    ok=True,
                    action=key,
                    data={
                        "tools": [
                            {
                                "name": r.name,
                                "summary": r.summary,
                                "domain": r.domain,
                                "needs_ui": r.needs_ui,
                                "confirm_required": r.confirm_required,
                                "risk": r.risk,
                            }
                            for r in self.catalog()
                        ],
                        "bridge": "none",
                    },
                    bridge="none",
                )
            handler = self._pure.get(key)
            if handler is None:
                return ToolResult(
                    ok=False,
                    action=key,
                    data={},
                    error=f"pure handler missing: {key}",
                )
            try:
                return handler(payload)
            except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001 — speak boundary
                return ToolResult(
                    ok=False,
                    action=key,
                    data={},
                    error=str(exc) or type(exc).__name__,
                )

        control_out = self._surface.invoke(key, payload)
        if control_out is None:
            return _requires_iris_ui(key)
        if not isinstance(control_out, dict):
            return ToolResult(
                ok=False,
                action=key,
                data={},
                error="invalid control result",
            )
        return _from_control(key, control_out)

    tools: tuple[str, ...] | None = None,
    allowlist: SpeakAllowlist = PHASE4_ALLOWLIST,
) -> None:
    """Boot check. Engine tool tuple must equal allowlist.names() — no MCP triple."""

    if tools is None:

    if tuple(tools) == mcp_triple:
        raise AssertionError("engine tools must not be the MCP triple")
    if tuple(sorted(tools)) != expected:
        raise AssertionError(
            f"engine tools must match allowlist names: got {tuple(tools)!r} "
            f"expected {expected!r}"
        )

# IRIS (Intelligent Responsive Interactive System) — 사업계획서 2026-2029 版本 1.0  /  2026-11-11  /  기밀  ────────────────────────────────────────  ## 1. Executive Summary  **IRIS** 는 사용자 단말(로컬 퍼스트)에서 실행되는 **개인형 AI 비서** 다.  - **핵심 가치**: 사용자 데이터·대화·지식이 클라우드에 올라가지 않고, 로컬에서만 완결되는 **데이터 주권형 AI**  - **차별점**: 단순 챗봇을 넘어 *상황 이해 → 판단 보조 → 작업 자동화* 까지 수행하는 **Agentic Assistant**  - **타깃**: 개발자·지식근로자·연구자·크리에이터 등 ‘자신만의 컨텍스트를 축적·재활용’하려는 전문가 집단  - **비전**: “당신의 두 번째 뇌, 첫 번째 동료”  ────────────────────────────────────────  ## 2. Problem & Opportunity  ### 2.1 현황  | Pain Point | 기존 해결책의 한계 | |------------|--------------------| | **데이터 유출·학습 재사용 우려** | 클라우드 LLM은 프롬프트·파일이 서버로 전송됨 | | **컨텍스트 단절** | 세션·디바이스·앱마다 기억이 공유되지 않음 | | **도구 파편화** | IDE, 브라우저, 메일, 캘린더, 위키가 각각 별도 AI | | **워크플로 자동화 부재** | “질문→답변” 1턴에 그치고, 멀티스텝 실행 불가 |  ### 2.2 시장 기회  - **전 세계 지식근로자 10억 명** 중 **로컬 퍼스트·프라이버시 중시층** 약 1.5억 명(TAM)  - **개발자·데이터 사이언티스트 3,500만 명** 중 **로컬 LLM 실행 환경 보유자** 약 500만 명(SAM)  - **초기 타깃(SOM)**: Iris Light / Obsidian / VS Code / Cursor 사용자 커뮤니티 ≈ 20만 명  ────────────────────────────────────────  ## 3. Product — IRIS Core  ### 3.1 아키텍처 개요  ```mermaid flowchart LR   subgraph Local_Device[사용자 단말]     UI[UI Layer<br/>Companion / IDE / CLI]     Core[IRIS Core<br/>Orchestrator + Memory + Skills]     LLM[(Local LLM<br/>llama.cpp / Ollama / LM Studio)]     Vault[(Encrypted Vault<br/>SQLite + Vector DB)]     Tools[Tool Runtime<br/>Python / Node / WASM]   end   UI --> Core   Core <--> LLM   Core <--> Vault   Core <--> Tools  ```  - **완전 로컬**: 네트워크 호출 **제로**(선택적 웹 검색 제외)  - **모듈형 스킬 시스템**: `skill_manage` 로 런타임에 스킬 동적 로드/언로드  - **멀티모달**: 텍스트·코드·이미지·PDF·오디오·비디오 처리  - **롱텀 메모리**: 대화·문서·코드·위키를 벡터 임베딩 + 그래프 인덱스로 통합 검색  ### 3.2 핵심 기능 (MVP → v1.0 → v2.0)  | 단계 | 기능 | 비고 | |------|------|------| | **MVP (Now)** | 로컬 LLM 채팅, 파일 읽기/쓰기, 터미널 실행, 위키 CRUD, 스킬 시스템, 브라우저 자동화 | 이미 동작 중 | | **v1.0 (Q1 2027)** | 멀티에이전트 협업(Planner/Executor/Critic), 워크플로 녹화·재생(Learning), 음성 I/O, 모바일 동기화 | 개발 중 | | **v2.0 (H2 2027)** | 자기 개선 루프(코드 리뷰→패치→테스트), 분산 노드 간 페더레이션, 엔터프라이즈 관리 콘솔 | 설계 완료 |  ### 3.3 스킬 생태계 (2026-11 기준 50+ 스킬)  - **생산성**: notion, airtable, google-workspace, xlsx, docx, pdf, powerpoint, email-inbox-triage  - **개발**: github, codebase-exploration, systematic-debugging, test-driven-development, requesting-code-review  - **리서치**: arxiv, grounded-citations, competitor-news-monitor, llm-wiki  - **크리에이티브**: claude-design, manim-video, p5js, architecture-diagram, data-visualization  - **미디어**: youtube-content, songsee, gif-search  - **로컬 퍼스트**: iris-browser, iris-email, iris-calendar, iris-wiki, iris-vibe-code, iris-session-status  ────────────────────────────────────────  ## 4. Business Model  ### 4.1 수익원  | 모델 | 가격(월) | 대상 | 비고 | |------|----------|------|------| | **Community** | Free | 개인·오픈소스 | 로컬 실행 완전 무료, 스킬 마켓 무료 | | **Pro** | $12 / $120 연 | 파워 유저 | 우선 지원, 고급 스킬(자동 코드 리뷰, 워크플로 녹화), 클라우드 동기화 옵션 | | **Team** | $30 / seat | 스타트업·연구실 | 공유 볼트, 팀 스킬 스토어, 감사 로그, SSO | | **Enterprise** | 협의 | 대기업·공공 | 온프레미스 배포, 모델 파인튜닝 지원, 보안 인증(ISO 27001, CSAP) |  ### 4.2 단위 경제 (예상, v1.0 출시 시점)  - **CAC**: $18 (커뮤니티 바이럴 + 기술 블로그 + GitHub Stars)  - **LTV (Pro)**: $1,440 (12개월 유지율 78%)  - **LTV (Team)**: $10,800 (seat × 36개월)  - **Gross Margin**: 92% (클라우드 GPU 비용 없음, 지원·스킬 유지보수만 발생)  ────────────────────────────────────────  ## 5. Go-to-Market Strategy  ### 5.1 Phase 0 – Community Flywheel (Now ~ Q1 2027)  1. **오픈소스 코어 공개** (MIT/Apache-2.0) → GitHub Stars 5k+  2. **스킬 마켓플레이스** 런칭 → 개발자 생태계 유입  3. **주간 데모 스트리밍** + 기술 블로그 → “로컬 AI = IRIS” 인식 고착  ### 5.2 Phase 1 – Pro Monetization (Q2 2027)  - Product Hunt / Hacker News 런칭  - 개발자 인플루언서·유튜버 협업 리뷰  - VS Code / Cursor / JetBrains 마켓플레이스 익스텐션 배포  ### 5.3 Phase 2 – Team/Enterprise (H2 2027~)  - 보안 감사 완료(SOC 2 Type II)  - 리셀러·SI 파트너 프로그램  - 공공·금융·국방 수요 대응(온프레미스·망분리 인증)  ────────────────────────────────────────  ## 6. Technology Moat  1. **로컬 퍼스트 오케스트레이터**: 네트워크 없이도 멀티턴·멀티툴·멀티모달 실행  2. **스킬 런타임 샌드박스**: WASM + 세캠프 필터로 서드파티 코드 안전 실행  3. **하이브리드 메모리**: 벡터(의미) + 그래프(관계) + 시계열(시간) 통합 검색  4. **자기 개선 루프**: 테스트 실패 → 패치 제안 → 회귀 테스트 자동화  5. **모바일-데스크톱 상태 동기화**: WebRTC P2P로 클라우드 없이 기기 간 컨텍스트 공유  ────────────────────────────────────────  ## 7. 경쟁 분석  | 경쟁사 | 강점 | 약점 | IRIS 승부처 | |--------|------|------|-------------| | **ChatGPT / Claude** | 거대 모델 품질, 클라우드 편의 | 데이터 유출, 오프라인 불가, 워크플로 자동화 약함 | **로컬·프라이빗·에이전틱** | | **Ollama / LM Studio** | 모델 서빙 간편 | 오케스트레이션·스킬·메모리·UI 부재 | **Full-stack Assistant** | | **Cursor / Copilot** | IDE 임베딩 강함 | IDE 밖 작업 불가, 로컬 모델 미지원 | **Cross-app, Model-agnostic** | | **LangChain / AutoGen** | 프레임워크 유연 | 제품화·UX·배포 난이도 높음 | **End-user Product** |  ────────────────────────────────────────  ## 8.                 errors.append(err or f"{rel} write failed")
                self._live_activity.append_instant_line(
                    f"project.write_file err: {errors[-1][:160]}"
                )
                continue
            self._tool_ok_count += 1
            self._live_activity.append_instant_line(
                f"[Iris local] project.write_file ok {rel}"
            )
        if errors and not turn_write_evidence(
            verified_path=str(getattr(self, "_turn_write_path", "") or ""),
            tool_written=bool((self._live_vibe or {}).get("tool_written")),
        ).wrote:
            return errors[0]
        return ""

    def _run_file_create_verify_turn(self, assistant: str):
        """VerifyTurn 한 진입점. (display, ask_or_err, VerifyResult)."""
        from iris.runtime.turn_verify import verify_file_create_turn

        ask_or_err = self._maybe_local_file_create_write(assistant)
        result = verify_file_create_turn(
            self._turn_evidence_for_chat(assistant or ""),
            failover_available=self._file_create_failover_available(),
        )
        return result.display, ask_or_err, result

구현과 검증을 마쳤습니다. 결론은 병렬 기능이 처음부터 없었던 것이 아니라, 외부 게이트웨이 방식에서 내부 단일 엔진 방식으로 전환되는 과정에서 깨진 회귀였습니다.

## 조사 결과

- Adobe 작업은 10:39경 웹 검색과 Adobe 오픈소스 페이지 수집까지 정상적으로 진행했습니다.
- 하지만 뒤이어 다른 채팅이 시작되면서 공유 사이드카가 선점·종료됐고 최종 답변이 생성되지 않았습니다.
- 실패한 백그라운드 슬롯이 `DONE` 처리되는 코드 때문에 UI에는 완료로 표시됐습니다.
- 제목 생성도 답변 성공 후에만 실행돼, 답변이 없는 Adobe 채팅은 기본 제목 그대로 남았습니다.

문서 작업은 다음 상태였습니다.

- [iris_business_plan.md](C:/Users/kwakm/.iris-light/agent/cache/scratch/iris_business_plan.md)는 10:47에 11,121바이트까지 작성됐습니다.
- 이후 파일은 갱신되지 않았으므로 현재도 작성 중인 것은 아닙니다.
- `note.export_pdf`가 엔진 도구 목록에 없어 실패한 뒤, 임시 Python 스크립트 생성과 PDF 존재 확인을 11:39까지 반복했습니다.
- PDF는 만들어지지 않았고 Markdown도 줄바꿈 없이 거의 한 줄로 저장돼 결과 품질은 좋지 않습니다.
- 반복 과정에서 컨텍스트 압축만 160초, 119초씩 걸렸고 동일한 파일 쓰기·실행 오류가 수십 회 반복됐습니다.

## 구현한 개선

- 내부 채팅마다 독립 사이드카를 fork하도록 변경했습니다. 이제 한 채팅 시작이 다른 채팅을 종료하지 않습니다.  
  [runtime.py](C:/Users/kwakm/Desktop/Cusor-Project/Project-IRIS-Light-main/iris/engine/runtime.py:417)  
  [hermes_workers.py](C:/Users/kwakm/Desktop/Cusor-Project/Project-IRIS-Light-main/iris/ui/workers/hermes_workers.py:538)

- `DONE`과 `FAILED`를 분리했습니다. 백그라운드 실패는 빨간 실패 배지로 남고, 해당 채팅을 열면 오류 내용도 표시됩니다.  
  [chat_activity.py](C:/Users/kwakm/Desktop/Cusor-Project/Project-IRIS-Light-main/iris/ui/monitor/chat_activity.py:9)  
  [main_window.py](C:/Users/kwakm/Desktop/Cusor-Project/Project-IRIS-Light-main/iris/ui/window/main_window.py:3244)

- `note.export_pdf`의 실제 JSON Schema, Hermes 도구 등록, `tool_request → UI ActionRegistry → tool_result` 브리지를 연결했습니다.  
  [speak_capability.py](C:/Users/kwakm/Desktop/Cusor-Project/Project-IRIS-Light-main/iris/infrastructure/speak_capability.py:159)  
  [_sidecar_main.py](C:/Users/kwakm/Desktop/Cusor-Project/Project-IRIS-Light-main/iris/engine/_sidecar_main.py:217)

- PDF 성공 판정은 실제 절대경로 파일의 크기, `%PDF-` 헤더, `%%EOF`까지 검증합니다.  
  [pdf_export.py](C:/Users/kwakm/Desktop/Cusor-Project/Project-IRIS-Light-main/iris/knowledge/pdf_export.py:125)

- 무한 재시도를 제한했습니다.
  - 같은 도구·같은 인수·같은 오류 3회
  - 한 턴의 전체 도구 오류 10회  
  [tool_error_budget.py](C:/Users/kwakm/Desktop/Cusor-Project/Project-IRIS-Light-main/iris/engine/tool_error_budget.py:40)

- 제목을 답변 성공과 분리했습니다. 사용자 메시지가 저장되는 즉시 휴리스틱 제목을 만들고, 답변 성공 시 생성된 모델 제목으로 갱신할 수 있습니다.  
  [main_window.py](C:/Users/kwakm/Desktop/Cusor-Project/Project-IRIS-Light-main/iris/ui/window/main_window.py:5283)  
  [conversations.py](C:/Users/kwakm/Desktop/Cusor-Project/Project-IRIS-Light-main/iris/storage/conversations.py:312)

- 엔진 가상환경이 삭제된 Python 3.14 실행 파일을 가리키는 문제도 확인했습니다. `WRONG_PYTHON` 상태일 때 자동 복구 설치를 한 번 시도하도록 변경했습니다.

- PEV의 V 검증은 실제 브리지로 PDF를 생성하고 실제 파일 바이트와 반환 경로를 확인하도록 강화했습니다.  
  [_check_agent_turn_tools.py](C:/Users/kwakm/Desktop/Cusor-Project/Project-IRIS-Light-main/iris/ui/_check_agent_turn_tools.py:55)
